verdict.rationale: Pilot is an accounting and bookkeeping service that handles sensitive financial data, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of retention settings, deletion requests, or data-lifecycle controls. The mention of keeping an existing QuickBooks account and historical data concerns continuity and portability, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
